name: Calm Under Pressure
desc: Steadier than they have any right to be.

name: Protective
desc: Puts themselves between danger and the others without thinking.

name: Quick Thinker
desc: First to an answer, right or wrong — usually right.

name: Compassionate
desc: People open up to them, even here.

name: Unshakable Faith
desc: Believes something larger is watching. Perhaps it is.

name: Resourceful
desc: Finds a use for everything, and a tool in anything.

name: Hard to Kill
desc: Has survived things that should have ended them.

name: Natural Leader
desc: When they speak, the room turns.

name: Skeptical
desc: Refuses the easy explanation. The train hates that.

name: Observant
desc: Notices the detail everyone else walks past.

name: Cowardly
desc: Wants to live more than they want to be brave.

name: Arrogant
desc: Certain they are the cleverest person in any carriage.

name: Reckless
desc: Acts first. Counts fingers later.

name: Suspicious
desc: Trusts no offer, no stranger, and increasingly no friend.

name: Compulsive Liar
desc: Lies even when the truth would serve better.

name: Vindictive
desc: Keeps a ledger of wrongs and always collects.

name: Addicted
desc: Something in their pocket matters more than it should.

name: Fatalistic
desc: Believes the destination is fixed. Acts accordingly.

name: Controlling
desc: Must hold the plan, the map, and everyone's decisions.

name: Easily Manipulated
desc: Wants so badly to be told what to do.

name: Terrified of Isolation
desc: Cannot bear to be alone, even for a moment, even here.

name: Refuses to Abandon Others
desc: Will go back. Will always go back.
